description: Duplicate campaigns, ad sets or ads, the same as Ads Manager's Duplicate. This is the default way to duplicate: use it whenever the user asks to duplicate, copy or clone. Optional reason is one short evidence-based note for the user in their Agent Inbox. Optional runTitle names this batch of suggestions. Pass the reviewId from an earlier preview or duplicate in this conversation to add the copy to that review, so the user approves the run together. Deep copy includes children by default; deepCopy:false copies only the root. Destination must be in the same account; ad sets default to their source campaign and ads to their source ad set. Rename supports {name}, {date} (UTC), {index}; only roots are renamed unless renameChildren:true. Roots default to PAUSED; children inherit source status unless childStatus:PAUSED. Preview warns about ACTIVE children inside a paused copy and flags flexible, partnership, Instagram-post and catalog ads that may not copy exactly; review copied ads before activating. Targeting, schedule and ad set settings overrides apply to copied ad sets. Ad set copies accept budget and bid_strategy overrides when the destination campaign uses ad set budgets (ABO), including copies from campaign-budget (CBO) campaigns. CBO-to-ABO ad set copies require overrides.budget.daily; preview returns ADSET_BUDGET_REQUIRED without a budget. Meta gives these copies a daily budget, so only a daily budget override is supported. Switching a copy between daily and lifetime budgets is refused at preview with BUDGET_TYPE_CHANGE_UNSUPPORTED, including ad sets inside deep campaign copies and CBO campaign copies. Source CBO ad sets have no budget of their own; the source campaign budget is never carried over. For CBO-to-ABO copies, overrides.bid.bid_strategy is required for capped or minimum-ROAS source campaigns or source ad sets with bid amounts or constraints (ADSET_BID_STRATEGY_REQUIRED); otherwise the strategy defaults to LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP. An explicit strategy takes precedence: capped strategies need a source or override bid_amount, and minimum ROAS needs VALUE optimization and a source ROAS floor or overrides.bid.roas_floor. Updates omit bid_amount when the chosen strategy does not allow it. Lifetime overrides on existing lifetime-budget sources still require a future end time from the source or overrides.schedule.end_time. When copying a CBO campaign, budget and bid_strategy apply to the copied campaign, including deepCopy:false for uncapped strategies; bid amounts and ROAS floors belong to copied ad sets. Capped CBO strategies require deepCopy:true with compatible source ad sets. add.countries adds countries, not a restriction; remove other source locations to target only those countries. Preview includes executionPlan call counts. Copies run serially, object by object, so Meta deep-copy child limits (3 synchronous / 51 async) do not apply. Large copies run as a background job; poll for progress. Always preview first, show the complete tree, skipped objects, overrides and warnings, then submit resolvedRequest with its sourceFingerprint. Set acknowledgeWarnings and confirmSpend only after explicit user approval. SOURCE_CHANGED means material source settings, the child tree, destination or copy intent changed since preview. Preview again, show the changes, and obtain approval for the new preview. Reviewed copies require a new approved proposal. Volatile delivery metadata does not invalidate the preview. SOURCE_GONE or DESTINATION_GONE means a selected source or destination is missing, deleted or archived. Copies follow the account's Agent Launch setting on the Account Permissions page, like launches; Agent Edit does not apply. Approval returns status "pending_approval" with reviewUrl; nothing has been duplicated yet: share it with the user, do not retry or apply again; approval happens in your Agent Inbox. Off refuses with AGENT_LAUNCH_DISABLED. Allowed (the default) starts a job; ACTIVE copies need confirmSpend:true unless the account approval rule is none. Hosted polling lasts about 40 seconds (local: up to 30 minutes), then still_running includes nextStep to ads_get_duplication; poll the same job until complete. Inspect every created and failed object; partial means some objects were created, but copying or a later step failed. Report each newId, current name, failed stage and plain error. Review copies use pending, approved, made, partial, failed or rejected; partial includes id, currentName, failedStep and retry.available/how. Retry only the failed step from your Agent Inbox when available, otherwise change the existing copy in Ads Manager. Never run the copy again; it would create a second copy. If the user explicitly wants to keep the existing likes, comments and shares (social proof), use ads_duplicate_by_post instead.

childStatus.description: Child objects inherit their source status by default, even under a PAUSED root. Use PAUSED to pause every copied child.

adSetId.description: Ad set to copy ads into. Ad copies only; the campaign comes from this ad set.

campaignId.description: Campaign to copy ad sets into. Ad set copies only.

expanded.description: Expanded source IDs returned by preview. The server re-reads children at apply.

adsetSettings.description: Edit ad set settings. destination_type is read-only. Meta validate_only checks objective, destination, billing and event compatibility.

attribution_spec.description: Standard attribution only. Turn incremental attribution off in a separate edit first.

roas_floor.description: Ad set only; 2.5 means 250%, stored as roas_average_floor 25000. Requires VALUE optimization and LOWEST_COST_WITH_MIN_ROAS at the budget owner.

budget.description: Budget in major account currency units. Ad set copies accept this when the destination campaign uses ad set budgets (ABO), including copies from campaign-budget (CBO) campaigns. Required for CBO-to-ABO ad set copies: preview returns ADSET_BUDGET_REQUIRED without overrides.budget. These copies have no budget of their own; the source campaign budget is never carried over. Their bid strategy defaults to LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP only when the source campaign is uncapped and the source ad set has no bid amount or constraints; otherwise supply overrides.bid.bid_strategy (ADSET_BID_STRATEGY_REQUIRED). Lifetime budgets require a future end time from the source ad set or overrides.schedule.end_time. When copying a CBO campaign, this overrides the copied campaign budget.

end_time.description: ISO timestamp with timezone. Null removes an end time.

targeting.description: Patch the current targeting without replacing unmentioned fields. Use ads_search_targeting for IDs. Preview includes per-path details and the full resulting audience, including every flexible_spec type. Advantage+ keeps a hard floor of 18-25 and uses age_range suggestions.

add.description: Adds to the source targeting. add.countries adds countries; it does not restrict targeting to them. To target only the US, add US and remove the other source countries with remove.countries; also remove any other source locations.

reason.description: One short note for the user explaining why (shown in their Agent Inbox).

reviewId.description: Add this copy to an existing review from ads_edit_preview or an earlier duplicate, so one run is approved together.

runTitle.description: Short name for this run. If the user names the run, use their exact words. Reuse it with the same reviewId. A run the user renamed keeps their name.

sourceFingerprint.description: Submit exactly the fingerprint returned by preview; required to apply.
